overall_summary: Most videos have very low view counts (under 50 views), indicating low overall channel distribution or a cold start phase. However, 'self respect' topics with highly specific smartphone UI/UX removal hooks (like status lists, pinned chats, blue ticks) show slightly better comparative traction than generic emotional poetry.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Jab Aapko Fark Padhna Band Ho Jaaye' (32 views) and 'Self Respect Status Story' (41 views) perform relatively better when focusing on micro-actions like status lists or chat lists.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on micro-interactions on the phone screen related to boundaries and letting go.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract Emotional Poetry without Tangible Objects
weak_patterns.evidence: Broad night thoughts or late-night abstract tea/room descriptions (e.g., 'रात के ख्याल', 'उप्म') have yielded single-digit or very low views (6-8 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely abstract concepts; anchor every emotional moment to a concrete physical or digital object.
